messages.author: bc04dbfec3d2f248
messages.subject: plyr::revalue should keep <NA> levels
parts:
Hi,

this is a feature request for plyr::revalue to keep <NA> levels if they are present is a factor variable. Below is an example showing that <NA> levels (added with addNA) are dropped. Would be great if they could be kept (broke some code of mine).

Cheers,
Chris

> f <- factor(c(TRUE, NA, FALSE))
> f
[1] TRUE  <NA>  FALSE
Levels: FALSE TRUE
> plyr::revalue(f, c("TRUE"="Yes", "FALSE"="No"))
[1] Yes  <NA> No  
Levels: No Yes
> # all fine

> # BUT:
> f2 = addNA(f)
> f2
[1] TRUE  <NA>  FALSE
Levels: FALSE TRUE <NA>
> plyr::revalue(f2, c("TRUE"="Yes", "FALSE"="No"))
[1] Yes  <NA> No  
Levels: No Yes
> # revalue has silently dropped the <NA> level
